tone: Use concise, neutral German with consistent polite or impersonal software phrasing.
capitalization: Follow German noun capitalization and use sentence case for labels.
button_labels: Use short conventional action labels and omit final periods.
ui_roles: Keep labels concise, buttons action-oriented, tooltips explanatory, and warnings or errors as natural complete sentences.
technical_terms: Prefer established German software terms and preserve glossary tokens.
contextual_terminology: Resolve ambiguous terms from the feature, stable ID, surface type, and neighboring strings; avoid literal English compounds when natural German differs.
punctuation: Use German quotation and punctuation rules while preserving accelerators.
units: Use metric conventions, comma decimals where applicable, and conventional unit spacing.
natural_language: Restructure compounds and clauses naturally instead of copying English order.
